DisplayDeviceAuthenticatorTests.cs
+23
-12

Package the fix and verify
Done
One file changes. Test-only fix — the production DapperDisplayDeviceAuthenticator is correct; the test helper was reading the scalar at the wrong type.

Root cause: ReadLastSeenAtAsync called ExecuteScalarAsync<DateTimeOffset?>. Npgsql materializes timestamptz as a UTC DateTime, and Dapper's Parse<T> falls through to Convert.DefaultToType, which has no DateTime → DateTimeOffset conversion. Same class of bug already fixed in TableDirectory, PersonDirectory, SittingDirectory, and DisplayDeviceDirectory — this scalar read was the one remaining site (I grepped the dump; there are no others).

Fix: read at DateTime?, project with the established new DateTimeOffset(DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc)) helper. DateTimeOffset.Equals compares the instant, so both Assert.Equal call sites are unaffected.

Path: tests/MyRestaurant.DataAccess.Tests/Displays/DisplayDeviceAuthenticatorTests.cs

Files to delete: none.
